description: This Java class 'PropertyBag' is designed for processing MQTT topic property bags, which are appended at the end of a topic URL to carry additional metadata as key-value pairs. The class provides methods to extract and retrieve properties from such topics, including creating a property bag from a topic string and accessing individual property values.

classes.name: PropertyBag
classes.description: A utility class for extracting and managing property key-value pairs embedded in MQTT topic strings.

methods.name: fromTopic
methods.description: Static factory method to create a PropertyBag instance by parsing the MQTT topic string to extract properties stored in the property-bag segment.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified property key from the property-bag, returning null if the property does not exist.

methods.name: topicWithoutPropertyBag
methods.description: Returns the original MQTT topic string minus the property-bag suffix.
